name: function 1

Page 1 Style
format:
<style>
/* ===== Page 1 - Clean Dark Theme ===== */

/* Page background */
.nrdb-page {
    background: #0f172a !important;
    font-family: 'Inter', 'Segoe UI', sans-serif !important;
}

/* Group card */
.nrdb-ui-group {
    background: #1e293b !important;
    border: 1px solid #334155 !important;
    border-radius: 14px !important;
    box-shadow: 0 4px 20px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4) !important;
    overflow: hidden !important;
    transition: box-shadow 0.3s ease;
}

.nrdb-ui-group:hover {
    box-shadow: 0 6px 28px rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.12) !important;
}

/* Group title bar */
.nrdb-ui-group .v-card-title,
.nrdb-ui-group .nrdb-ui-group-name {
    background: linear-gradient(135deg, #1e293b 0%, #0f172a 100%) !important;
    color: #e2e8f0 !important;
    font-size: 15px !important;
    font-weight: 600 !important;
    letter-spacing: 0.5px !important;
    padding: 12px 16px !important;
    border-bottom: 1px solid #334155 !important;
}

/* Widget/card area */
.nrdb-ui-widget-content {
    background: #1e293b !important;
    color: #cbd5e1 !important;
}

/* Gauge styles */
.nrdb-ui-gauge svg text {
    fill: #e2e8f0 !important;
    font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif !important;
}

.nrdb-ui-gauge svg .gauge-value {
    fill: #38bdf8 !important;
    font-weight: 700 !important;
    font-size: 1.4em !important;
}

/* Chart background */
.nrdb-ui-chart canvas {
    border-radius: 8px;
}

/* Text/label color override */
.nrdb-ui-text {
    color: #94a3b8 !important;
}

/* Scrollbar */
::-webkit-scrollbar {
    width: 6px;
}
::-webkit-scrollbar-track {
    background: #0f172a;
}
::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb {
    background: #334155;
    border-radius: 3px;
}
::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb:hover {
    background: #38bdf8;
}
</style>

<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin>
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Inter:wght@400;500;600;700&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">

function 4

function 5
func:
msg.topic = `
SELECT
    id,
    device_time,
    phase_id,
    voltage,
    current,
    power,
    energy,
    recorded_at
FROM pzem_3phase_logs
ORDER BY recorded_at DESC
LIMIT 500
`;
return msg;
